C098.notes: SER EU-ES-001. National side Cathedral of Santiago de Compostela · ESPAÑA left · 2000 right · crowned M · 12 EU stars · user shorthand 2 5s 2000 and 2002 + photo (left flip). First-year Spanish euro date — struck before cash day, the pilgrim cathedral already on copper that would not spend until 2002. Same 1/2/5€c national type; Joseph called these 5s. Country #19 — first Spain flip in the vault (Mexico was bullion-only). Someone later dropped this in a café till on the Camino’s capital city money. SER siblings: EU-ES-002 · EU-ES-003 (cathedral 1€c ladder). Spain flips now 3.
C098.story: A 2000 Spanish 5-euro-cent coin. Spain's side shows the Cathedral of Santiago de Compostela, designed by Garcilaso Rollán. The other side, shared by every euro country, was designed by Luc Luycx. Struck in copper-plated steel.
